power.better_origins.merling_kin.name: Sea Kinship
power.better_origins.merling_kin.descrip: Drowned and guardians don't attack you. If you hit one, it becomes hostile towards you for 15 seconds.
power.better_origins.fins.name: Fins
power.better_origins.blaze_hydrophobia.d: You take damage over time while in water or rain.
power.better_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.better_origins.nether_born.descrip: You are 20% faster in the Nether (like Speed I).
power.better_origins.internal_heat.name: Internal Heat
power.better_origins.internal_heat.descr: The fire inside you burns energy: you get hungry faster.
power.better_origins.fireball.name: Fireball
power.better_origins.fireball.descriptio: Shoot a small fireball where you are looking. 3 second cooldown.
power.better_origins.nether_diet.name: Nether Diet
power.better_origins.nether_diet.descrip: You can eat crimson and warped fungi.
power.better_origins.blazeborn_kin.name: Fire Kinship
power.better_origins.blazeborn_kin.descr: Blazes and magma cubes don't attack you. If you hit one, it becomes hostile towards you for 15 seconds.
power.better_origins.gift_of_the_winds.d: Every 30 seconds, you can launch yourself about 40 blocks into the air.
power.better_origins.soft_landing.name: Soft Landing
power.better_origins.brittle_wings.name: Brittle Wings
power.better_origins.brittle_wings.descr: You take 50% more damage when you fly into a wall.
power.better_origins.sky_lord.name: Lord of the Sky
power.better_origins.sky_lord.descriptio: Phantoms never attack you, not even if you hit them.
power.better_origins.slender_body.name: Slender Body
power.better_origins.slender_body.descri: You can reach blocks further away (+2.5) and creatures a bit further away (+1.5).
power.better_origins.end_eyes.name: Eyes of the End
power.better_origins.end_eyes.descriptio: Endermen don't get angry when you look them in the eyes.
power.better_origins.enderian_kin.name: End Kinship
power.better_origins.enderian_kin.descri: Endermen, endermites and End creatures from supported mods don't attack you. If you hit one, it becomes hostile towards you for 15 seconds.
power.better_origins.arthropod.name: Arthropod
power.better_origins.arthropod.descripti: You are an arthropod: Bane of Arthropods hurts you more.
power.better_origins.venom_bite.name: Venomous Bite
power.better_origins.venom_bite.descript: Each of your hits, melee or projectile, has a 50% chance to poison the target for 3 seconds.
power.better_origins.web_throw.name: Web Throw
power.better_origins.web_throw.descripti: Throw a cobweb. If it hits a creature or a player, it traps them in a real cobweb; if it hits a block, the cobweb drops and stays where it lands. 2 second cooldown.
power.better_origins.arachnid_kin.name: Spider Kinship
power.better_origins.arachnid_kin.descri: Spiders, cave spiders and spiders and centipedes from supported mods don't attack you. If you hit one, it becomes hostile towards you for 15 seconds.
power.better_origins.large_appetite.name: Large Appetite
power.better_origins.large_appetite.desc: You get hungry a little faster than others.
power.better_origins.levitation_burst.de: Make mobs and players within 5 blocks levitate for 3 seconds, except Shulk and pets; the area lights up purple. 8 second cooldown.
power.better_origins.shulker_shell.name: Shulker Shell
power.better_origins.shulk_float.name: Float
power.better_origins.shulk_float.descrip: Hover in the air for up to 15 seconds: hold jump to rise, sneak to descend. The time recharges while you are not floating.
power.better_origins.shulk_heavy.name: Heavy Body
power.better_origins.shulk_kin.name: Shulker Kinship
power.better_origins.shulk_kin.descripti: Shulkers don't attack you. If you hit one, it becomes hostile towards you for 15 seconds.
power.better_origins.phantom_phasing_tog: Toggle at will: walk through solid blocks, except obsidian. You become translucent but NOT invisible. Needs more than 6 hunger and drains hunger.
power.better_origins.phantom_veil.name: Shadow Veil
power.better_origins.phantom_veil.descri: Toggle at will: become invisible for up to 30 seconds. The time recharges while you are visible. Needs more than 6 hunger and drains hunger.
power.better_origins.phantom_hunger.name: Fast Metabolism
power.better_origins.phantom_hunger.desc: Each active form makes you hungry; with both, hunger drains twice as fast.
power.better_origins.phantom_sunburn.des: In sunlight, unless invisible, you catch fire. Sun Protection on your helmet reduces it: I = you burn half the time, II = a quarter, III = never.
power.better_origins.moon_armor.name: Moon Armor
power.better_origins.moon_armor.descript: At night you take 20% less damage (like Resistance I).
power.better_origins.nocturnal.name: Nocturnal
power.better_origins.nocturnal.descripti: You can see well in the dark, except underwater.
power.better_origins.feline_sprint.name: Feline Sprint
power.better_origins.pounce.name: Pounce
power.better_origins.pounce.description: Leap forcefully where you are looking, leaving a white trail behind you. 3 second cooldown, costs a little hunger.
power.better_origins.perfect_heart.name: Strong Heart
power.better_origins.perfect_heart.descr: You have 11 hearts instead of 10. This bonus is always kept.
power.better_origins.perfect_body.name: Perfect Body
power.better_origins.perfect_body.descri: +20% speed, higher jump (+20%), +20% mining speed, +150% swim speed, -20% knockback, +1.5 block reach for blocks and creatures.
power.better_origins.perfect_healing.des: All healing you receive is 10% stronger, natural regeneration included.
power.better_origins.perfect_strength.de: Always like Strength I and Resistance I: +3 melee damage and 20% less damage taken.
power.better_origins.perfect_eyes.name: Keen Eyes
power.better_origins.perfect_eyes.descri: You see better in the dark (50%).
power.better_origins.adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
power.better_origins.adrenaline.descript: When you are about to die, if you have at least 10 experience levels and Adrenaline is ready, it triggers by itself and uses 10 levels: you go back to about 5 hearts, you are invincible for 5 s, Regeneration II for 30 s; for 15 s Strength III, Speed III, Jump Boost III, full night vision, +200% swim speed and no knockback; for 30 s +50% mining speed. Then comes the crash: for 90 s you lose all bonuses (except the 11th heart). The bar shows Adrenaline in red and the crash in blue; when it is empty, Adrenaline is ready again. If you die, it is ready again right away.
power.better_origins.evolved_gills.name: Evolved Gills
power.better_origins.evolved_gills.descr: With the Evolved Gills enchantment on your helmet you breathe longer out of water: I = 1 minute, II = 3 minutes, III = you breathe normally.
origin.better_origins.perfect_human.name: The Perfect Human
origin.better_origins.perfect_human.desc: A human at the peak of their abilities: stronger, faster and tougher in everything. When death comes, Adrenaline puts them back on their feet, but then the body crashes.
power.better_origins.wind_charge.name: Wind Charge
power.better_origins.wind_charge.descrip: Throw a Breeze's wind charge where you are looking. You store up to 3 and can throw them one after another; each used charge recharges in 10 seconds, one at a time.
origin.better_origins.superior_bat.name: Superior Bat
origin.better_origins.superior_bat.descr: A creature of the night. When the sun goes down it takes to the sky and hears every heartbeat around it, but daylight burns its skin and weakens its blows.
power.better_origins.bat_flight.name: Night Wings
power.better_origins.bat_flight.descript: At night (and always outside the Overworld) double-jump to fly for up to 30 seconds; sprint while flying to go much faster. The time recharges while you are not flying. Flying costs extra hunger. If your flight ends in the air you glide down for 7 seconds.
power.better_origins.bat_echo.name: Echolocation
power.better_origins.bat_echo.descriptio: Toggle at will: for up to 15 seconds you see the outline of every mob within 64 blocks and every player within 32 blocks, even through walls (only you see them), while your body glows with a white aura. The time recharges while it is off.
power.better_origins.bat_night_vision.de: You can see well in the dark.
power.better_origins.bat_night_speed.des: You are 15% faster at night (and always outside the Overworld).
power.better_origins.bat_soft_fall.name: Light Body
power.better_origins.bat_frailty.name: Small Frame
power.better_origins.bat_sun_weakness.de: Under direct sunlight your attacks deal 25% less damage, even with Sun Protection.
While flying you take 50% more damage from projectiles.
origin.better_origins.road_runner.name: Road Runner
origin.better_origins.road_runner.descri: Born to run. Nothing on legs is faster, and anything in your way when you are at full speed regrets it - including walls.
power.better_origins.rr_dash.name: Speed Burst
power.better_origins.rr_dash.description: Toggle for up to 30 seconds: walking +50%, sprinting 3 times faster, and you run up full blocks like slabs. Recharges while off. Uses a lot of hunger while on.
power.better_origins.rr_swift_legs.name: Swift Legs
power.better_origins.rr_impact.name: Hard Impact
power.better_origins.rr_impact.descripti: Running into a wall at least 2 blocks tall (at your feet and head, or at your head and above) while sprinting with Speed Burst hurts you badly - the faster you go, the more it hurts.
power.better_origins.rr_stun.name: Stunning Strike
power.better_origins.rr_stun.description: Hitting a mob or player while sprinting with Speed Burst stuns them for 3 seconds: frozen in place and blind. They can't be stunned again for 1.5 seconds (mobs) or 5 seconds (players). The Ender Dragon is immune.
power.better_origins.rr_metabolism.name: Fast Metabolism
power.better_origins.rr_metabolism.descr: You get hungry 20% faster (300% more while Speed Burst is on).
power.better_origins.rr_frailty.name: Light Frame
origin.better_origins.cave_worm.name: Cave Worm
origin.better_origins.cave_worm.descript: A born miner who belongs under the stone. Underground it is fast, tough and sharp-eyed; under the open sky it feels slow and exposed.
power.better_origins.cw_surface_mining.d: Under the open sky you mine 10% faster.
power.better_origins.cw_deep_mining.name: Deep Digger
power.better_origins.cw_deep_mining.desc: Under a roof, or in any other dimension, you mine 35% faster.
power.better_origins.cw_surface_sluggish: Under the open sky you sprint 15% slower and lose your night vision.
power.better_origins.cw_deep_speed.name: Tunnel Runner
power.better_origins.cw_deep_speed.descr: Underground you walk and sprint 10% faster.
power.better_origins.cw_deep_vision.name: Dark Sight
power.better_origins.cw_deep_vision.desc: Underground you can see in the dark.
Under the open sky you heal 20% slower.
power.better_origins.cw_prospector.name: Prospector
power.better_origins.cw_prospector.descr: Everything you mine drops as if your tool had one more level of Fortune (no Fortune counts as Fortune I).
power.better_origins.cw_frailty.name: Soft Body
power.better_origins.cw_parasites.name: Cave Parasites
power.better_origins.cw_parasites.descri: Toggle for up to 15 seconds: mobs, players and pets within 6 blocks (not your pets, not other Cave Worms) catch parasites that grow the longer they stay: damage that ignores armour (even on undead and spiders), slowness and darkness, deadly from level 6. 5 second cooldown after switching it off.
origin.better_origins.angel.name: Angel
origin.better_origins.angel.description: A gentle guardian. It can keep its blessings for itself, share them with everyone around it, or both - but heaven's grace takes time to return.
You can see a little in the dark.
power.better_origins.angel_grace.name: Grace
power.better_origins.angel_grace.descrip: You slowly regenerate health (half a heart every 5 seconds).
power.better_origins.angel_frailty.name: Delicate
power.better_origins.angel_soft_fall.des: Toggle at will: you fall 20% slower and take no fall damage.
power.better_origins.angel_selfish.name: Blessing: Self
power.better_origins.angel_selfish.descr: Toggle: you get +15% speed, +20% attack speed, +15% damage, Resistance I and Regeneration I. Uses the blessing time (30 seconds). The area around you lights up.
power.better_origins.angel_altruist.name: Blessing: Others
power.better_origins.angel_altruist.desc: Toggle: the 3 blessings chosen in the blessing menu go to every player and pet within 10 blocks, you included, and the area lights up. With both blessings on the time runs out twice as fast. After switching everything off you must wait 30 seconds.
power.better_origins.angel_blessing_menu: Press your 4th ability key to choose which 3 blessings you give to others.
gui.better_origins.blessings.title: Blessings for others
